name: companion-tools-catalog
description: The companion catalog is readable and honest from the UI alone. Settings → Resources names how many of the catalog answer on this machine, each row states its own detection state and version, a ready tool can be re-checked, and a tool that is not installed shows its own install guidance and download page instead of pretending to be available. The journey does not install anything: the mission forbids changing this machine's toolchain, and the catalog's contract is that OR never downloads or installs from this screen. It also proves the one-click setup control exists for a tool that states its command.

steps.detail: the catalog reports how many tools answer, not that OR ships them
a tool that answered is shown ready with the version it reported
a ready tool can be checked again without leaving the screen
FFmpeg is headless, so OR does not offer to open it as a window
a tool that is not installed offers guidance, not a launch
re-checking a ready tool leaves no failure behind
a tool whose catalog entry states a command can be set up from this screen instead of a terminal
the download page stays available for a tool the app cannot install by itself
